title: US-short §8 组合级熔断 (portfolio_guard) governance — const-pins the account-level circuit-breaker state set + per-state effects + paper-track trigger + the no-data-is-not-safe fail-safe
description: Batch-1 declarative governance contract. Freezes the §8 portfolio_guard_status state set {normal, caution, cooldown, recovery} (== action_table vocab), the per-state design-locked effects (caution = reduce size + reduce weekly new count; cooldown = block new entry + block add + holding-risk-control only; recovery = only a few high-confidence new; normal = baseline), the trigger model (primary = model_paper_track §12 when evaluable: consecutive stops / paper drawdown over threshold; secondary = manual actual account = advisory), and the fail-safe (if the paper track is not_evaluable/data_degraded the guard must NOT be clean — '没数据不当安全'). advisory_only: affects advice only, never auto-trades. Threshold VALUES (consecutive-stop count, drawdown %) are forward priors routed to §13.1 #22, not pinned. Tight scope: portfolio_guard only; 削减叠法 / macro_cluster / symbol_cooldown / cash_allocation / ship-gate sizing are separate §8 slices. draft-07 cannot express: state set == action_table, provenance of each pinned mechanic in §8, and threshold_calibration_item_id ∈ the lifecycle registry — enforced in tests.

portfolio_guard_states.description: §8 portfolio_guard_status ∈ {…} — exact state set/order, const-pinned byte-faithful; == action_table portfolio_guard_status vocab.

state_effects.description: §8 per-state design-locked effects (fixed boolean set per state).

triggers.description: §8 trigger model — primary model_paper_track (§12, when evaluable); secondary manual account = advisory.

fail_safe.description: §8 fail-safe — paper track not_evaluable/data_degraded ⟹ guard not clean (没数据不当安全).

advisory_only.description: §8 只影响建议、不自动交易.

threshold_calibration_item_id.description: §8 阈值 prior → §13.1 #22 (组合熔断阈值: 连续止损/回撤 + 各状态档).
